jobs.title: Director, Global Insurance Data Solutions
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274459

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, Global Insurance Data Solutions leads a dedicated Global Insurance data solutions function within the Global Wealth Management (GWM) Data Management Office. This role is accountable for building the data foundations, operations, governance, quality and analytics-enablement capabilities required to support Global Insurance business priorities across Canada and international markets.

The portfolio covers Canadian and International creditor and non-creditor insurance, GWM Insurance, and Insurance Distribution and Operations. The Director will define the target operating model, establish stakeholder relationships, recruit the initial team and sequence delivery of foundational insurance data capabilities.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Define the Global Insurance data strategy, mandate, operating model and multi-year roadmap.
Establish governance forums, service expectations, prioritization and performance measures.
Build a scalable team and delivery model aligned to GWM and enterprise standards.
Lead data hunting, source assessment, requirements, profiling and implementation.
Establish governed insurance data assets and reusable products for operations, reporting and analytics.
Coordinate delivery across business, technology, data engineering and enterprise partners.
Establish ownership, stewardship, metadata, privacy classification, lineage and quality controls.
Direct remediation of critical data issues and support audit, regulatory and risk obligations.
Implement sustainable operational controls, monitoring and issue escalation.
Serve as the primary Data Management Office relationship lead for Global Insurance lines of business.
Recruit, develop and lead the dedicated Insurance Data Solutions team.
Communicate roadmap, dependencies, outcomes and risks to senior stakeholders.
Create an inclusive, high-performance environment and build succession and development plans
Communicate a clear vision, translate strategy into measurable outcomes and hold the team accountable for delivery.
Promote effective day-to-day controls and sound risk decisions consistent with governing policies and standards.
Build collaborative partnerships across business lines and enterprise functions.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? – We’d love to work with you if you have:

An Undergraduate degree in business, technology, data, finance or a related discipline
Progressive experience leading enterprise data, analytics, technology, operations or product teams in a large, regulated organization
Experience in insurance data, operations, distribution, actuarial, finance or regulatory reporting
A demonstrated ability to define strategy, lead complex portfolios and deliver through cross-functional teams
Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata, privacy, controls and modern data platforms
Executive-level communication, stakeholder management, financial judgment and people leadership capabilities

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

jobs.title: Director, Technical Product Management - Platform Engineering & Cloud Services
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274773

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Team

Global Wealth Banking and Markets Engineering (GWBMT) is the fast-moving, award-winning technology engine that powers Scotiabank's Wealth and Capital Markets businesses.

The Platform Engineering organization provides the foundational technology platforms and cloud services that enable application teams to innovate rapidly, securely, and at scale. Our portfolio includes enterprise Kubernetes platforms spanning on-premises and Google Cloud environments, Cloud Enablement Services, Kafka as a Service, Airflow as a Service, Fine-Grained Access Management capabilities, and future developer platform offerings that accelerate application modernization and cloud adoption.

The Role

We are seeking a Director, Technical Product Management – Platform Engineering & Cloud Services to lead the product strategy, roadmap, adoption, and delivery of a portfolio of enterprise platform products that serve hundreds of engineers and mission-critical applications across the bank.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, product management, engineering, and business strategy. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and evolving platform products that enable cloud adoption, application modernization, developer productivity, security, and operational excellence.

As a senior product leader, you will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and application development teams to ensure our platforms deliver measurable business value, exceptional user experiences, and scalable solutions that meet the needs of a rapidly evolving enterprise landscape.

You will act as the voice of the engineering customer while balancing engineering priorities, platform sustainability, risk management, and strategic technology objectives.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership
Define and execute the strategic vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management of a portfolio of platform engineering products and services.
Develop product strategies that accelerate cloud adoption, platform standardization, application modernization, and engineering productivity.
Identify emerging customer needs and market trends to drive innovation and platform evolution.
Establish product success metrics, adoption goals, customer satisfaction targets, and business outcomes.
Prioritize investments and roadmap initiatives based on business value, engineering impact, risk reduction, and operational efficiency.

Product Portfolio Includes

Enterprise Kubernetes Platforms (On-Prem and Google Cloud)
Cloud Enablement and Migration Services
Airflow as a Service
Kafka as a Service
Fine-Grained Access Management Platforms
Developer Platform Capabilities and Self-Service Engineering Solutions
Customer Engagement & Platform Adoption
Act as the primary advocate for platform consumers across GBM and enterprise engineering teams.
Build deep understanding of customer journeys, pain points, and platform adoption barriers.
Drive platform onboarding strategies and self-service experiences that improve developer productivity.
Partner with application teams to identify modernization opportunities and accelerate cloud migration initiatives.
Lead customer advisory forums, feedback programs, and adoption reviews to continually improve platform offerings.
Establish product analytics frameworks and measurable indicators to track platform utilization, customer outcomes, productivity gains, and business value realization.
Technical Product Ownership
Translate strategic objectives into clear product roadmaps, capabilities, requirements, and delivery plans.
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to define platform capabilities, service offerings, APIs, and user experiences.
Ensure platform products align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Define service offerings, operating models, support models, and service-level objectives (SLOs) for platform products.
Champion platform engineering principles, self-service capabilities, automation, and developer experience improvements.
Establish service consumption metrics, cost transparency models, showback/chargeback capabilities, and platform ROI measures.
Delivery Leadership & Execution
Lead the planning and execution of platform product initiatives from ideation through delivery and adoption.
Partner with engineering leaders to balance feature development, platform reliability, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence.
Drive agile product delivery practices, roadmap governance, backlog prioritization, and release planning.
Track delivery performance and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives across multiple platform teams.
Manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations across a complex enterprise environment.
Platform Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence
Define and monitor key platform performance indicators, including availability, reliability, scalability, security, adoption, and customer satisfaction.
Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and Operations teams to improve platform resiliency and operational maturity.
Ensure security controls, access governance, and compliance requirements are embedded within platform services.
Drive continual improvement initiatives focused on automation, observability, service health, and cost optimization.
Balance innovation with operational stability and risk management.
Own the end-to-end platform user experience across onboarding, self-service workflows, documentation, observability, support engagement, and lifecycle management.
Stakeholder Management & Executive Communication
Build strong relationships with senior technology leaders, architects, engineering teams, security stakeholders, and business partners.
Present product strategy, investment priorities, roadmap progress, and platform value realization to executive leadership.
Influence strategic technology decisions across cloud, platform engineering, developer experience, and modernization initiatives.
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

10+ years of technology experience with at least 5 years in Product Management, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Developer Platforms, or Infrastructure Services.
Proven experience leading the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of large-scale platform products.
Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure, and application modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of platform engineering, developer experience, self-service platforms, and product operating models.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple organizations.
Experience leading cross-functional teams in complex enterprise environments.
Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
Strong strategic thinking, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container platforms operating across hybrid-cloud environments.
Experience with public cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, Kafka, streaming platforms, and modern data infrastructure.
Understanding of workflow orchestration and data engineering platforms such as Apache Airflow.
Knowledge of Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Fine-Grained Authorization, and Zero Trust security principles.
Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, platform automation, observability, and reliability engineering practices.
Understanding of platform security, risk management, compliance, and operational resilience requirements.

Preferred

Experience building or managing Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and self-service engineering ecosystems.
Background in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Architecture, or Software Engineering.
Experience driving enterprise cloud transformation and migration programs.
Experience within financial services, capital markets, or other highly regulated industries.
Knowledge of Google Cloud technologies including GKE, networking, observability, and security services.

Success Measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured By

Platform adoption and customer satisfaction
Growth of cloud-enabled and modernized applications
Developer productivity improvements and self-service adoption
Reliability, availability, and operational performance of platform services
Reduction in onboarding friction and time-to-market
Delivery of strategic roadmap commitments
Platform cost optimization and operational efficiency
Achievement of security, compliance, and risk management objectives

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) will play a key leadership role within the Corporate Finance organization, overseeing the FP&A team and partnering with senior leaders to strengthen enterprise planning, forecasting, and performance management. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, strong business acumen, disciplined organizational skills, knowledge of financial analysis tools and techniques, and exceptional communication skills. This leader must be able to develop a highly engaged team, operate effectively in a rapidly growing and complex environment, and help guide the company toward its long-term business objectives.

Reporting to the Group CFO, Enterprise and Corporate, this role leads the enterprise FP&A function and partners closely with Accounting, Operations, Corporate Finance, Business Intelligence, and other key stakeholders.

Duties And Responsibilities

Establish the governance framework and execution strategy for the enterprise FP&A organization.
Partner across company functions, including Operations, Development, and Corporate Finance, to align on business performance, monthly results, forecasts, and risks and opportunities.
Lead all aspects of the annual budgeting process, including target setting, coordination, consolidation, analysis, and executive presentations.
Lead high-priority ad hoc projects and analyses of key business issues, providing senior leadership with actionable insights that support timely decisions.
Leverage available and newly developed systems data to create management reporting for assigned business lines and/or the enterprise.
Maintain and enhance internal financial planning and reporting tools to create a highly efficient and effective FP&A function.
Collaborate with business intelligence to create real time actionable analysis
Create and maintain management reports for monthly, quarterly, and annual analysis containing profitability analysis, segment metrics, and capital utilization analysis.
Understand and effectively communicate cost drivers in the organization.
Presents financial and operational results to senior management on a regular and ad-hoc basis, including trends and competitive analysis giving full insight into the Company’s P&L.
Prepare presentations and provide critical input into senior management discussions and strategy planning
Development of business intelligence presentations for disbursing data to management in visual format
Lead compilation, consolidation rollup, and analysis of annual budgets and forecasts
Set the direction for driving efficiencies across all areas within the enterprise FP&A organization
Create a diverse and inclusive environment
Act as a talent steward for employees, including identifying and developing staff, educating and empowering, and assessing opportunities to realign work and team structure to ensure optimal efficiency and productivity.
Lead financial innovation and change.
Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant responsibility for budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial analysis; experience in both public accounting and private industry is preferred.
5+ years of experience managing staff
Accounting, M&A and/or finance background preferred
Advanced experience with use of Excel required
Experience leading a department or functional area
Advanced financial modeling skills required, including sophisticated use of Excel, pivot tables, data-query tools, and other contemporary modeling techniques; experience with automation tools, including macros and SQL, is preferred.
Experience using Business Intelligence tools (i.e. Tableau, SAP, Power BI, etc.)
Experience with consolidation and financial systems also required
Demonstrated background in creating/improving processes and process management
Hands-on leadership style with a proven ability to drive results
Demonstrated ability to advise business leaders, define complex business problems, and develop decision-support analyses related to financial performance, business planning, strategic opportunities, and business cases.
Demonstrated ability to effectively articulate an issue or point of view to a varied audience both verbally and in writing
Strong communication skills including demonstrated ability to interact with senior management and influence outcomes across all levels of the organization
Ability to meet rigorous deadlines of a growth-oriented company; ability to multi-task and prioritize responsibilities, coordinate and manage multiple commitments simultaneously
Solid values and high standards of ethics, integrity, and trust
Experience collaborating with stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of the company.
Experience diagnosing, isolating, and resolving complex issues and recommending and implementing strategies to resolve problems
Demonstrated ability to analyze and define business problems in order to prepare decision-support analysis on a range of issues related to financial performance, business planning, strategic opportunities, and business case analysis
Experience in healthcare, hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and joint ventures preferred.
Demonstrated executive presence, including the ability to communicate credibly, influence senior leaders, and represent the FP&A function in high-stakes discussions.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field required; MBA or CPA highly preferred.

KEY COMPETENCIES

Deep Financial Planning & Analysis Capabilities: The successful candidate must possess significant FP&A experience, including the ability to develop and maintain a comprehensive financial projection model.
Problem Solving & Analytical Orientation: Uses excellent problem-solving and analytical skills to track, analyze, interpret, and report key historical and projected operating metrics, trends, and financial results. Can take a deep dive into business details while maintaining focus on the broader strategic picture.
Results Oriented: Thinks strategically and executes tactically, integrating technical, creative, business, and communication skills to deliver results.
Effective Communication and Decision Making: Conveys important messages clearly and persuasively, makes timely decisions when circumstances require a rapid response, and demonstrates outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
Brand Momentum
– Vice President Finance

Do you want your next role to provide a significant opportunity to build a lasting legacy, not just maintain someone else’s creation? Are you motivated by transforming finance from a reporting function into a strategic growth engine? Can you turn complex data into clarity for a leadership team, Board and Private Equity owners?

GlassRatner is excited to be partnering with Brand Momentum at a pivotal stage in its evolution. Following its acquisition by CPS Capital Partners, the company is entering an exciting new chapter of growth, investment, and value creation. We are seeking a highly strategic and commercially minded Vice President, Finance to join the Executive Leadership Team and help shape the future of one of Canada's leading sales, merchandising, experiential marketing, and retail workforce solutions organizations.

With a team more than 2,000 strong supporting some of the world's most recognized consumer brands across Canada, Brand Momentum has built its reputation on exceptional service, strong execution, and long-standing client relationships. As the business continues to scale, the organization is looking for a finance leader who can elevate finance from a traditional reporting function into a strategic driver of performance, profitability, and growth.

The Mandate

This is more than a finance leadership role – it is a build opportunity. The mandate for the incoming Vice President, Finance is to transform the finance function into a proactive business partner that drives strategic decision-making, operational excellence, and enterprise value creation.

Over the next 12–24 months, the successful candidate will:
Establish a best-in-class planning, forecasting, and performance management framework
Improve the speed and quality of financial reporting
Build out meaningful FP&A capabilities
Strengthen visibility into customer and service-line profitability
Develop KPI dashboards that support operational decision-making
Lead the implementation, integration, and optimization of a new ERP system, ensuring it delivers stronger integration, reporting, forecasting, and operational visibility

Leadership and Stewardship

This role calls for more than a finance executive – it calls for a business leader who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. The right candidate is equally comfortable working through detailed financial information, coaching their team, collaborating with operational leaders, presenting to executives, and helping solve day-to-day business challenges.

They bring an ownership mindset, challenge conventional thinking, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and are passionate about building a stronger, more profitable organization.

As a key member of the Executive Leadership Team, the Vice President, Finance will play a critical role in helping Brand Momentum improve operational performance, strengthen financial discipline, and achieve its long-term growth objectives.

Ideal Background

The ideal candidate will bring progressive finance leadership experience within a growth-oriented, entrepreneurial, or private-equity-backed environment. They may currently be a Vice President of Finance, Director of Finance, Head of FP&A, or senior finance leader seeking broader strategic influence and enterprise-wide responsibility. About KLONDIKE

For over 35 years, KLONDIKE Lubricants has challenged the status quo to become one of Canada’s leading independent manufacturers and marketers of high-performance commercial, industrial, and automotive lubricants, greases, and specialty chemicals.

KLONDIKE manages a portfolio of more than 650 SKUs and sells exclusively through a distributor network of over 700 independent distributors across Canada and the United States. These distributors, in turn, serve a wide range of end markets including automotive, heavy-duty on-road and off-road, mining, forestry, agriculture, and industrial applications.

KLONDIKE does not sell directly to end users or mass merchandisers. This disciplined approach has allowed the company to build long-term, trust-based partnerships and consistently deliver profitable growth.

Building on its strong Canadian foundation, KLONDIKE is also in the early stages of expanding its presence in the United States. This growth is intentional and disciplined, following the same distributor-focused model that has driven success in Canada, and represents an important next chapter in the company’s long-term growth strategy.

KLONDIKE’s business model is built around one simple guiding principle: We Grow Independent Business.

This philosophy shapes how the company designs products, sets pricing, manages inventory, delivers service, and partners with distributors. KLONDIKE is positioned just below the global majors on price, while meeting or exceeding required industry specifications and certifications. The company competes on value, trust, availability, and technical credibility — not on being the cheapest option in the market.

Manufacturing and warehousing are fully outsourced to long-term strategic partners, while KLONDIKE invests heavily in inventory across six warehouses. Supply chain reliability and product availability are core competitive advantages and key drivers of distributor loyalty.

www.klondikelubricants.com

Investors

KLONDIKE Lubricants is backed by Snowdon Partners, a private equity firm focused on helping companies grow and reach their full potential.

Snowdon Partners brings a collaborative and supportive approach to value creation, providing strategic guidance, access to expertise, and additional resources to help scale the business. As part of this partnership, the finance function benefits from the perspective of an experienced Private Equity CFO, offering mentorship, strategic insight, and thought partnership while empowering the Director of Finance to lead the function and grow with the organization.

www.snowdonpartners.ca

The Role

KLONDIKE Lubricants is seeking a high caliber Director of Finance to lead and further strengthen the company’s finance function as the business continues to scale in size, complexity, and ambition. This role represents a significant leadership opportunity for a finance professional who is ready to operate at a senior level today, with a clear runway to take on broader responsibility over time.

The Director of Finance will play a central role in ensuring financial discipline, reliability, and insight across the organization, while remaining closely connected to the day-to-day financial operations of the business. This is a role for a finance leader who takes ownership, values precision, and understands the importance of strong fundamentals in enabling sustainable growth.

Who You Are

You are a finance leader who takes pride in owning the numbers and understands that credibility is built by staying closely connected to the business. You bring a naturally investigative mindset, seeking to understand the “why” behind the results, not just the outcomes. You operate comfortably across both strategic and operational levels, maintaining a strong focus on accuracy, control, and timely execution.

You bring strong technical accounting capability paired with sound business judgment. You believe that financial leadership starts with disciplined execution; timely closes, reliable reporting, and robust controls, but you also know that the real value of finance lies in enabling better decisions, managing risk, and supporting growth.

You are energized by complexity and change, and you operate effectively in environments where priorities evolve and judgment matters. You ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and take ownership of outcomes rather than deferring responsibility.

You operate effectively in complex, evolving environments where priorities shift and judgment matters. You ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and take ownership of outcomes rather than deferring responsibility.

You are comfortable partnering closely with the CEO and Leadership Team, providing clear insight and perspective without slowing the organization down. You communicate confidently with external lenders and support Board-level reporting with clarity and professionalism.

You are motivated by the opportunity to support a business expanding beyond Canada into the U.S. market. While grounded in strong Canadian financial fundamentals today, you view geographic expansion as an opportunity to help the business scale thoughtfully and to broaden your own exposure and impact over time.

You are comfortable operating in financially complex, inventory-intensive environments. You understand the nuances of multi-warehouse inventory accounting, high SKU counts, and product costing, and you bring experience managing foreign exchange exposure related to cross-border payables and inventory purchases. You are also comfortable supporting financial consolidation across multiple legal entities, navigating increased scale and cross-border complexity as the business grows.

You thrive in entrepreneurial, growth-oriented businesses and see runway ahead, an opportunity to grow your scope, influence and leadership impact as KLONDIKE continues to scale.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Controls

Oversee the company’s full accounting and financial reporting function
Ensure timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close
Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
Develop, implement, and maintain appropriate financial controls and policies
Build and refine KPIs and management dashboards to support decision-making
Prepare annual budgets and rolling forecasts, track performance against plan
Serve as the internal source of truth for financial performance and insight

Hands-On Accounting & Cash Management

Review and verify work performed by the Controller and accounting team
Maintain active involvement in transactional accounting as required
Oversee weekly bank reconciliations and cash forecasting
Actively manage working capital, including receivables, payables, and inventory
Support working capital optimization in an inventory-intensive, multi-warehouse environment
Prepare audit support schedules and coordinate with external accountants

Lender, Board & Governance Support

Lead relationships with senior lending partners
Prepare monthly bank reporting packages and compliance metrics
Support Board reporting with clear, concise financial materials and analysis
Ensure compliance with credit agreements and governance requirements

Strategic & Operational Support

Partner with the CEO and Leadership Team on financial planning and analysis
Support long-term financial planning, scenario analysis, and forecasting
Analyze product lines, pricing, margins, inventory, and distribution economics
Evaluate investments, operational initiatives, and growth opportunities

Risk, Tax & Compliance

Oversee sales tax filings and ongoing compliance
Coordinate corporate tax filings with external advisors
Support government audits and regulatory inquiries
Manage insurance programs and periodically review coverage
Support foreign exchange exposure management related to suppliers
Own and manage the company’s foreign exchange risk, including monitoring exposure and executing an appropriate hedging policy

Systems & Process Improvement

Ensure effective integration between ERP (SAP), CRM, WMS, and accounting systems
Act as a finance lead on system enhancements and implementations
Identify opportunities to automate or streamline recurring finance processes

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop the Controller and accounting team
Set clear standards for accuracy, accountability, and performance
Foster a culture of continuous improvement and professionalism
Support talent development and succession planning within the function

Your Profile

7+ years of progressive experience in accounting and finance, including leadership roles
Strong technical accounting foundation with solid knowledge of ASPE
Experience in distribution, manufacturing, industrial, or inventory-intensive environments is an asset

Demonstrated ability to operate hands-on while managing broader responsibilities
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail

High integrity, sound judgment, and a practical, business-oriented mindset

Partner with application teams to identify modernization opportunities and accelerate cloud migration initiatives.
Lead customer advisory forums, feedback programs, and adoption reviews to continually improve platform offerings.
Establish product analytics frameworks and measurable indicators to track platform utilization, customer outcomes, productivity gains, and business value realization.
Technical Product Ownership
Translate strategic objectives into clear product roadmaps, capabilities, requirements, and delivery plans.
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to define platform capabilities, service offerings, APIs, and user experiences.
Ensure platform products align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Define service offerings, operating models, support models, and service-level objectives (SLOs) for platform products.
Champion platform engineering principles, self-service capabilities, automation, and developer experience improvements.
Establish service consumption metrics, cost transparency models, showback/chargeback capabilities, and platform ROI measures.
Delivery Leadership & Execution
Lead the planning and execution of platform product initiatives from ideation through delivery and adoption.
Partner with engineering leaders to balance feature development, platform reliability, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence.
Drive agile product delivery practices, roadmap governance, backlog prioritization, and release planning.
Track delivery performance and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives across multiple platform teams.
Manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations across a complex enterprise environment.
Platform Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence
Define and monitor key platform performance indicators, including availability, reliability, scalability, security, adoption, and customer satisfaction.
Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and Operations teams to improve platform resiliency and operational maturity.
Ensure security controls, access governance, and compliance requirements are embedded within platform services.
Drive continual improvement initiatives focused on automation, observability, service health, and cost optimization.
Balance innovation with operational stability and risk management.
Own the end-to-end platform user experience across onboarding, self-service workflows, documentation, observability, support engagement, and lifecycle management.
Stakeholder Management & Executive Communication
Build strong relationships with senior technology leaders, architects, engineering teams, security stakeholders, and business partners.
Present product strategy, investment priorities, roadmap progress, and platform value realization to executive leadership.
Influence strategic technology decisions across cloud, platform engineering, developer experience, and modernization initiatives.
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

10+ years of technology experience with at least 5 years in Product Management, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Developer Platforms, or Infrastructure Services.
Proven experience leading the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of large-scale platform products.
Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure, and application modernization initiatives.

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container platforms operating across hybrid-cloud environments.
Experience with public cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Knowledge of Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Fine-Grained Authorization, and Zero Trust security principles.
Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, platform automation, observability, and reliability engineering practices.

Preferred

Experience building or managing Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and self-service engineering ecosystems.
Background in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Architecture, or Software Engineering.
Experience driving enterprise cloud transformation and migration programs.
Experience within financial services, capital markets, or other highly regulated industries.

new_jobs.title: Information Technology - Senior Director, Enterprise Systems & AI Enablement
new_jobs.description:
The Company

Cineflix Media 

Cineflix creates, produces, and distributes must-watch TV for global platforms, with operations in Montreal, Toronto, Vancouver, New York, Los Angeles, London, and Dublin. A leading international media company, the group includes top-ranking sales and acquisitions division, Cineflix Rights, as well as production labels Buccaneer and C3 Media. With a catalogue of 7,600 hours of select programming across a wide range of genres and a collection of YouTube and FAST channels streaming 24/7, Cineflix is behind some of TV’s most popular and long-running shows. 

The Role

Cineflix Media is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Systems & AI Enablement to lead the practical implementation of our enterprise AI and technology transformation agenda.
This cross-functional role will work across the organisation to identify opportunities, modernise systems, redesign processes and embed effective AI-enabled ways of working. 

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Senior Director will partner closely with IT and leaders across Cineflix to translate business priorities into practical, measurable outcomes. Initial areas of focus may include Cineflix’s finance, rights management, production budgeting, payroll and planning systems, but the scope of the role extends across the organisation. This is a full-time role based in our Toronto, Ontario office on a hybrid, in-office schedule.

The Salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 - $200,000

Key Responsibilities 

Lead the implementation of Cineflix’s enterprise AI agenda across corporate and operational functions.
Identify and prioritise practical AI and automation opportunities that improve productivity, accuracy and decision-making.
Translate business requirements into scalable AI-enabled solutions and workflows.

·       Lead the development and deployment of Cineflix-owned LLM capability for internal processes, reducing reliance on external tools and ensuring solutions are tailored to Cineflix’s workflows, data, security and governance requirements.
·       Establish responsible AI practices in partnership with IT, Legal, Privacy and business leaders.
Collaborate with Creative AI leadership to align governance while maintaining clear areas of accountability.
Develop and deliver a roadmap for modernising, connecting and, where appropriate, consolidating Cineflix’s core business systems.
Improve the quality, accessibility and governance of enterprise data.
Reduce reliance on manual processes, disconnected systems and uncontrolled spreadsheets.
Lead systems integration, automation and modernisation initiatives in partnership with IT and functional leaders.
Evaluate technology partners and solutions based on business value, security, scalability and cost.
Lead the successful adoption of new systems, AI tools and redesigned processes.
Partner with business leaders and HR to support communications, training and skills development.
Help teams understand and adapt to changing roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
Build shared ownership across functions and address barriers to adoption and measure implementation progress, employee adoption and realised business benefits.

Experience and Capabilities

Senior experience in enterprise technology, AI enablement, business systems or digital transformation.
Demonstrated success implementing practical AI, automation and workflow solutions.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation programmes.
Strong knowledge of enterprise systems, data governance, cybersecurity and vendor management.
The ability to connect business needs with practical technology solutions.
Strong stakeholder management, change leadership and communication skills.
A collaborative, pragmatic and execution-focused leadership style.
Experience in media, entertainment, production or another project-based organisation would be an asset.

This posting reflects an existing vacancy. Cineflix does not use artificial intelligence in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this role.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your resume and cover letter to the Director, Human Resources, Mackenzie Graham via the link. No phone calls please. We thank all applicants, but only those selected will be contacted.

Cineflix Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a diverse environment. Cineflix welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Job Information

Job Title: Director, System Planning

Director, Change Management

Job Requisition ID: 87913

Ministry: Primary and Preventative Health Services

Location: Edmonton

Full or Part-Time: Full Time

Hours of Work: 36.25 hours per week

Permanent/Temporary/Wage: Permanent

Scope: Open Competition

Closing Date: October 8, 2026

Classification: Management Senior Manager Zone 2

Salary: $5,139.3 to 6,526.16 bi-weekly ($134,135.73 - $170,332.78/year)

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

The Ministry of Primary and Preventive Health Services (PPHS) is building a more resilient and sustainable health care system that can support Albertans getting care when and where they need it, while responding to system-wide health challenges, improving health outcomes and maintaining fiscal responsibility.

Role Responsibilities

The Primary Care Corridor Transformation team is seeking two experienced and strategic leaders to fill the positions of Director, Change Management and Director, System Planning. These positions play a key role in advancing Alberta’s primary care transformation agenda through strategic leadership, stakeholder collaboration, system planning, and change implementation. The successful candidates will lead complex initiatives that support a more integrated, accessible, and sustainable primary and preventative health care system for Albertans.

Director, Change Management

Key Responsibilities:

Lead stakeholder engagement and change management strategies that support the successful implementation of primary care transformation initiatives across Alberta.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with health system partners, government ministries, health care providers, and community stakeholders to foster collaboration and alignment.
Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior leadership on stakeholder issues, implementation risks, emerging opportunities, and transformation priorities.
Develop and implement change management, communication, and stakeholder readiness plans that support sustainable system change.
Lead complex consultations and engagement activities to inform decision-making, build consensus, and advance government priorities.
Identify and mitigate risks, barriers, and interdependencies that may impact the successful delivery of transformation initiatives.
Provide leadership to a multidisciplinary team while fostering a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing work environment.

Director, System Planning

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the development and implementation of strategies, frameworks, and system plans that support the transformation of Alberta’s primary and preventative care system.
Assess current and emerging health system needs, service gaps, trends, and system pressures to inform planning priorities and strategic decision-making.
Provide strategic advice to senior leadership on complex health system issues, policy considerations, service delivery models, and system improvement opportunities.
Lead the development of recommendations and implementation approaches that support Primary Care Corridor Transformation initiatives.
Use data, evidence, and stakeholder input to inform planning, policy development, and decision-making.
Establish effective governance, accountability, and risk management processes to support planning activities and major initiatives.
Provide leadership to a multidisciplinary team while fostering a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing work environment.

The JR87913 Director System Planning JD i s provided for Further details on this position
.

The JR87916 Director Change Management JD is provided for Further details on this position
.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

Systems Thinking
: Applies a broad health system perspective to identify interdependencies, anticipate emerging issues, and integrate stakeholder, operational, and policy considerations into strategic decision-making.

Build Collaborative Environments
: Builds and leads high-performing teams while fostering collaboration among government, health system, and community partners to achieve shared objectives and drive transformational change.

Develop Networks
: Cultivates and leverages strategic relationships across government, the health sector, and stakeholder organizations to build alignment, influence outcomes, and advance ministry priorities.

Creative Problem Solving
: Navigates complex and ambiguous challenges by identifying opportunities, evaluating risks, and developing practical, evidence-informed solutions that support transformational outcomes.

Agility
: Leads effectively in a dynamic environment by adapting to changing priorities, responding to emerging issues, and guiding teams and stakeholders through complex change initiatives.

Qualifications

University graduation in a related field such as Health Administration, Public Administration, Public Policy, Business Administration, or a Health Sciences, supplemented by seven years of progressively responsible experience. Related experience or education may be considered as an equivalency on a one of one basis:

Assets
:

Experience working within Alberta’s health system, particularly in primary care, preventative care, or health system transformation.
Experience working with Primary Care Networks, Primary Care Alberta, health care providers, or other health sector partners.
Experience leading large-scale health-system transformation initiatives involving multiple organizations, stakeholders, and governance structures.
Experience developing health system strategies, policy frameworks, implementation plans, or system-level improvement initiatives.
Experience using data, evidence, and health information to support strategic planning, policy development, and executive decision-making.

Minimum recruitment standards outline the minimum education and experience required for appointment to a job classification.

Notes

Hours of work are 08:15 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday.

This competition will be used to fill two (2) full-time permanent Director positions, working 36.25 hours per week, located in downtown Edmonton.

Final candidates will be required to undergo a criminal records check (CRC).

Any costs associated with obtaining the required documents/checks as noted or interview travel expenses, will be the responsibility of the candidate. Out-of-province applicants can obtain the required documents/checks from the province they currently reside in.

How To Apply

Applicants are advised to provide information that clearly and concisely demonstrates how their qualifications meet the advertised requirements, including education, experience, and relevant examples of required competencies.

Candidates are required to apply for a job online. Please see Job Application Resources for information.

In your resume, please include dates (including months and years) associated with all education and work experience. For example, January 2006 - June 2009 (part-time). This example is provided for illustrative purposes only. Applicants are encouraged to present their information clearly and thoroughly, using a format that best conveys their experience.

It is recommended applicants who have completed post-secondary studies from outside of Canada obtain an evaluation of their credentials from the International Qualifications Assessment Service (IQAS) or from a recognized Canadian Credential Evaluator; please visit the Alliance of Credential Evaluation Services of Canada for more information .

It is recommended that applicants include the assessment certificate from IQAS or any other educational assessment service as part of their application.

Closing Statement

This competition may be used to fill future vacancies, across the Government of Alberta, at the same or lower classification level.

We thank all applicants for their interest. All applications will be reviewed to determine which candidates' qualifications most closely match the advertised requirements. Only individuals selected for interviews will be contacted.

If you require any further information on this job posting or require an accommodation during the recruitment process, please c ontact Elena Arefeva at Elena.Arefeva@gov.ab.ca .
